_about: Reviewed map: take-off item -> Tamil Nadu PWD rate. 'sor' = a finished-work rate printed in the TN SOR; 'sd' = TN Standard Data Book item analysed with TN SOR basic rates (variant index, optional 'bind' wiring of components the book names generically or defines in a sub-data block, 'ignore' for printed extras that do not apply, 'factor' converting the analysed unit to the take-off unit); 'suggest' = a TN SOR line that is shown to the engineer but NOT priced until confirmed; 'needs' = NEEDS RATE / NEEDS RATE ANALYSIS. 'band' = plausibility range (Rs per take-off unit) — outside it the rate is rejected, not used.
